title: Concept: Gemfile resolves a gem from a local path
description: Gemfile declares a gem that installs from a directory on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The build compiles whatever that directory holds, so the artifact is not reproducible from the Gemfile.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: The build compiles whatever that directory holds, so the artifact is not reproducible from the Gemfile.
